packageRules.description: Sample project shipped for the demo, not a dependency of this repo.
Terraform providers use unbounded >= constraints; only surface a PR when the floor genuinely moves.

Keep lerna's minimatch resolution in theia/package.json on 3.x: lerna breaks on minimatch 11 (#155, reverted in #158), and 3.x is outside the affected range of GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249. A GitHub alert raises every minimatch below its newest patched version, skips the major approval and overrides enabled: false, so allowedVersions is the only cap that holds. Resolutions on an affected major still get the security PR.
